explication: OmniWM is a macOS tiling window manager. The principal workflow is user input or application-window events entering the controller, being interpreted against settings and window rules, then producing workspace layouts and applying window geometry through macOS accessibility APIs. The README documents Niri-style scrolling and Dwindle layouts, monitor routing, and optional CLI/IPC automation. The tree and sampled references support additional UI and utility branches, but unsampled implementation details and some subsystem connections are not asserted.
